topic: rocket equation (guard: log of a same-unit ratio must read as dimensionless)
statement: A rocket in free space ejects exhaust at speed u relative to itself. Its mass drops from m0 to mf. Find the change in its speed.

topic: spring launch speed (guard: difference of derived-unit terms under a root)
statement: A block of mass m sits on a vertical spring of stiffness k compressed by x, then is released. Find its speed when the spring reaches its natural length.
